note: Published list prices, entered by hand and dated. A model absent from this file is reported unpriced, never zero -- see ADR-004. Every report that quotes a cost also quotes rate_table_version, so a figure can be reproduced against the rates that produced it.

deepseek/deepseek-flash.basis: Peak cache-miss input and peak output rates, the highest the page lists for this model, so an estimate is an upper bound on what the vendor bills: off-peak rates are half, and cache-hit input is cheaper still. Page model version DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; off-peak $0.15 input (cache miss), $0.003 (cache hit), $0.60 output.
